text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angola's council of ministers said in a statement it is concerned with the slow pace of the peace process. The members said they were especially worried that the government of national unity and reconciliation had not yet been established.
- The Huambo provincial government said it was making preparations to accommodate UNITA members into its structures.
